So they removed tail sounds entirely from the weapon soundbanks, there’s now some internal logic to calculate them we don’t have. This does only apply to automatic weapons, so the mxlr might be safe? But under the hood there were so many changes to the sound player the safe option is to rebuild the guns from scratch by ripping them through assetripper/asgui/blender/unity to get a working container using our versions of those scripts. If you have any more questions feel free to hit me up here or on discord.

By the way…. We already have a big backport mod in the works, I had to add new functionality to commonlib for hideout customizations but we’re getting there. Just giving you a heads up 😉

comments.author: Rehael_RC
comments.body_html: Depends on your game’s location but it should be somewhere on ; “C: > SPT 4.X.X > SPT > SPT_Data > database > templates > quests.json” from there you need to find all quest’s ID such as “5bc4776586f774512d07cf05” for example. It’s easier done with the search function “Ctrl + F” which can be used to search the term “Shooter”. Then you use the downward arrow to get to every function’s line of code of every quest and you need to edit every “weapon” id list with the MXLR’s weapon ID in the list. It should display in the server that there’s a syntax error but it still works.

comments.author: Rehael_RC
comments.body_html:
Edit from before; since I know there’s some lazy ones here, there is the MXLR’s ID : “67c6de3ce39861860909e8e5”

IMPORTANT : Don’t forget to respect the whole syntax in the .json file otherwise it WON’T work. It’s also better to write directly the MXLR’s ID since a copy past from this website into the .json file seems to make a weird syntax issue that can be countered by simply writing it correctly by hand. (Keep in mind that if you modify anything in the .json file and it breaks you game, the SPT help team WON’T help since you changed something the in the game files itself. If you don’t want to deal with this, just wait the 1.0.0 release and the quest’s lists update there) :cheers:
